Issue #331: Separate post-retry-exhaustion re-evaluation recovery. The flow must distinguish retry exhaustion from post-fix re-evaluation, record recovery operations in issue-log/artifacts, allow one explicit recovery re-evaluation when implementation diff or evidence changed, and keep stopping when the same failure repeats.
